proof.text: For composable f and g, identify the pullback of kernelSubobject g along f with kernelSubobject (f ≫ g). Prove both subobject inclusions by the kernel and pullback universal properties (Subobject.isPullback, pullback_factors, kernelSubobject_factors, kernelSubobject_arrow_comp). Apply this to the maps f and g of [def-sp-exact-couple].

Use exact_g of [def-sp-exact-couple] at (p+3,q-2). Transport its codomain along the integer equalities (p+3)-1=p+2 and (q-2)+1=q-1, proved by omega. Substitution reduces the transported statement to exact_g. This gives ker g = im a and, by rewriting the pullback identity, ker d = f inverse(im a).

Factor f as factorThruImageSubobject f followed by (imageSubobject f).arrow. The first factor is epi. The already proved source-library lemma CategoryTheory.Limits.imageSubobject_comp_of_epi (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subobject.Limits) removes that epimorphic precomposition from the image of d. Rewrite exact_alpha of [def-sp-exact-couple] to obtain the kernel-alpha variant and retain exact_alpha itself as the sixth clause.

The kernel condition kernel.ι d ≫ d = 0, with d = f ≫ g from [def-sp-exact-couple], factors kernel.ι d ≫ f through kernelSubobject g. Apply imageSubobject_le to this factorization and substitute ker g = im a. Assemble the seven clauses.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks homology.tex Section 12.21 (Lemma 011R, proof omitted; Definitions 011Q, 011S; Lemma 011T; Remark 0AMJ with its footnote) and Section 12.5 (Lemmas 08N5, 05PK, 010C). Statement generalized from the type-0 couple of def-sp-exact-couple to an exact couple of type s (g of bidegree (s,-s)), which the iteration needs: the derived couple of a type-0 couple has g' of bidegree (1,-1), so the induction for C_r runs over types r-2; for s=0 the statement is the old one. Claims stated as before (ker d, im d, well-definedness of alpha', f', g', exactness of the derived couple, D_r = im alpha^{r-2}, bidegrees). Proof written in 12 steps: element calculus with elements T -> X up to epimorphic refinement (Stacks 011T/08N5; Mathlib Refinements.lean, new Mathlib-leaf node lem-sp-abelian-refinements), d o d = 0, the two subobject identities, the three constructions by universal properties (epi = cokernel of its kernel, def-sp-abelian), the three exactness chases, assembly, and the induction on r. No Freyd-Mitchell; differences of elements are differences in Hom(T,X). Proof is agent-written (Stacks omits it). Searches: the item's earlier five plus leansearch, leanfinder and grep; Mathlib has no exact couples.

theorem derived_couple_kernel_identities {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {s : ℕ} (X : BigradedExactCouple C s) :
    ∀ p q : ℤ,
      let a : X.D (p + 3) (q - 2) ⟶ X.D (p + 2) (q - 1) :=
        X.alpha (p + 3) (q - 2) ≫ eqToHom (by congr 1 <;> omega)
      kernelSubobject (X.d p q) =
          (Subobject.pullback (X.f p q)).obj (kernelSubobject (X.g (p + 2) (q - 1))) ∧
      kernelSubobject (X.d p q) =
          (Subobject.pullback (X.f p q)).obj (imageSubobject a) ∧
      kernelSubobject (X.g (p + 2) (q - 1)) = imageSubobject a ∧
      imageSubobject (X.d p q) =
          imageSubobject ((imageSubobject (X.f p q)).arrow ≫ X.g (p + 2) (q - 1)) ∧
      imageSubobject (X.d p q) =
          imageSubobject ((kernelSubobject (X.alpha (p + 2) (q - 1))).arrow ≫
            X.g (p + 2) (q - 1)) ∧
      imageSubobject (X.f p q) = kernelSubobject (X.alpha (p + 2) (q - 1)) ∧
      imageSubobject (kernel.ι (X.d p q) ≫ X.f p q) ≤ imageSubobject a
